column1: #mapping_set_description: One AnnotationHub resource as returned by https://annotationhub.bioconductor.org/ahid/<AH id> (pretty-printed JSON from AnnotationHubServer3.0 formatId()). The same data lives in the hub's annotationhub.sqlite3 and is what mcols(<AnnotationHub>) shows in R. Array members (rdatapaths, input_sources) are flattened to 'array[].field' keys whose values are lists, one item per array member.
